messages.context: Enid 提到 Gavin 用指令代替打开钓鱼技能菜单
messages.raw: §fI know that §bGavin §fuses §d/scg §finstead of looking in his §aFishing Skill §fmenu.
messages.text: I know that Gavin uses /scg instead of looking in his Fishing Skill menu.
messages.gloss: Gavin 是 NPC 人名,/scg 是服务器指令,均保留原样。
messages.zh: 我知道 Gavin 不查看自己的钓鱼技能菜单,而是使用 /scg。

messages.context: Enid 说所有人都知道 Gavin 在偷懒
messages.raw: §fHe thinks he's being sneaky, but everyone knows about it.
messages.text: He thinks he's being sneaky, but everyone knows about it.
messages.zh: 他以为自己神不知鬼不觉,其实大家早就知道了。

messages.raw: §fLittle does he know, I use it too!
messages.text: Little does he know, I use it too!
messages.gloss: it 指上一句的 /scg 指令。
messages.zh: 他不知道的是,我也用这个指令!

messages.raw: §fThe §2Backwater Bayou §fhas all sorts of wild §3Sea Creatures §fnative to the area.
messages.text: The Backwater Bayou has all sorts of wild Sea Creatures native to the area.
messages.zh: 穷乡河湾生活着各式各样的本地野生海洋生物。

segments.zh: 生活着各式各样的本地野生

messages.raw: §fI've heard stories of §cFrog Man§f, but I've never quite worked out if he's a frog or a man.
messages.text: I've heard stories of Frog Man, but I've never quite worked out if he's a frog or a man.
messages.zh: 我听说过Frog Man的故事,但一直没弄明白他究竟是青蛙还是人。

segments.text: , but I've never quite worked out if he's a frog or a man.
segments.zh: 的故事,但一直没弄明白他究竟是青蛙还是人。

messages.text: Perhaps he is both, perhaps neither.
messages.zh: 也许两者都是,也许两者都不是。
